verdict.rationale: Goodwin's locations page says it has 18 of its own offices across North America, Europe, and Asia, including London, Munich, Paris, Luxembourg, Brussels, Hong Kong, and Singapore. Practice pages add multi-jurisdiction reach, citing privacy specialists across the US and Europe, UK incentives expertise, and a global tech team. Missing for 10: evidence that the non-US offices offer founder-focused startup work such as local entity formation or venture financings (the VC page says 'nationwide' and Document Driver covers only Delaware), and independent corroboration beyond the firm's own pages.
